title: Pornography Addiction
description:
These daily affirmations are designed to support individuals recovering from pornography addiction.
Recovery is a journey of renewing the mind, restoring healthy relationships, developing self-control, and
living with integrity and purpose. These affirmations encourage self-compassion, resilience, emotional
awareness, and authentic connection. They are intended to complement professional counseling,
accountability, healthy coping strategies, and support from trusted individuals or recovery communities.

safety.disclaimer: This programme complements counselling, hypnotherapy, EFT, and trusted accountability. It is not a medical cure.
safety.reminder:
Recovery from pornography addiction is a process of growth, not perfection. Setbacks do not erase
progress-they are opportunities to learn, strengthen your coping skills, and continue moving
forward. With self-compassion, healthy boundaries, accountability, and appropriate support, lasting
freedom and healthy relationships are achievable.

activities.title: Closing affirmation and forward plan
activities.affirmation:
I am not defined by my past habits or struggles. I am defined by my courage to change, my
commitment to integrity, and my desire to become the best version of myself. Every day I choose
recovery, I renew my mind, strengthen my character, and build healthier relationships. One thought,
one decision, and one day at a time, I am creating a life of freedom, self-respect, and lasting
fulfillment.
